results.content: But while Republicans made notable gains among some minority voters in the 2024 presidential election, more recent polling suggests those gains should not be interpreted as a broad or continuing realignment toward the GOP. Pew Research Center found that 48% of Hispanic voters backed Trump in 2024, up from 36% in 2020.
